writeup: TIC 467976427 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 3.886797 days, identified through automated analysis of TESS photometry data. The primary eclipse produces a 13.03% dimming, while a secondary eclipse was not detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal originates from the target location, with a centroid offset of 4.7 arcsec and a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise ratio of 105.9. The detection achieves a BLS signal-to-noise of 638.2. However, the eclipses show significantly alternating depths - a pattern suggesting the actual period is twice what initial processing identified. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a potentially new object worthy of further investigation.
